task: Generate one photorealistic still frame in the style of a casual vertical selfie video an original fictional man films of himself with his phone front camera, in his bathroom in the morning, to show his audience a skincare product he uses. It will be used as the first frame of a talking-head video, so it should feel candid and authentic, like a frame from an everyday phone video.

output.look: raw, unedited iPhone front-camera video frame, not a professional photo

subject.identity: an original, non-famous Latin American man, 28 years old
subject.face: light-medium olive skin with natural texture (visible pores, a couple of tiny blemishes, faint under-eye lines), hazel-brown eyes, natural brows, slight natural facial asymmetry
subject.hair: short black hair, slightly damp and casually pushed back, a few strands falling forward
subject.facial_hair: clean-shaven with a faint natural shadow on the jaw

wardrobe.top: plain heather-gray crew-neck cotton t-shirt, a soft well-worn fabric, natural fabric wrinkles
wardrobe.style: relaxed morning at-home clothes, nothing flashy, no visible logos

pose_and_expression.position: standing at the bathroom counter, upper body leaning very slightly toward the camera
pose_and_expression.gaze: looking directly into the lens, making eye contact with the viewer
pose_and_expression.expression: calm, confident and friendly, a subtle natural half-smile, as if about to start talking; mouth closed or barely parted, relaxed jaw
pose_and_expression.hands: his right hand holds a small amber glass dropper bottle with a black rubber dropper cap and a plain cream-colored label with no text, at chest height, the bottle clearly visible; his left hand rests relaxed on the counter edge in the lower part of the frame; fingers relaxed, all fingers anatomically correct and fully visible
pose_and_expression.posture: shoulders relaxed and square to the camera, natural and unposed

environment.location: a clean, simple bathroom in the morning
environment.background: a wall of white rectangular tiles, a wooden shelf with two rolled beige towels and a small green plant, a matte black towel ring, softly out of focus, uncluttered
environment.foreground: the edge of a white sink counter at the lower edge of the frame with a ceramic cup and a folded hand towel, slightly out of focus
environment.atmosphere: tidy, real, lived-in home bathroom, not a staged studio set

camera.device: iPhone front camera propped against the bathroom mirror at chest-to-eye height, slightly below eye level, facing him
camera.lens: wide-angle selfie lens (about 24mm equivalent) with its natural mild perspective
camera.framing: medium close-up from the waist up, subject centered horizontally; his head sits in the upper-middle of the frame (eyes at about 38% of the frame height from the top), leaving clean empty space above his head for on-screen graphics
camera.focus: face and bottle sharp, background softly in focus as a phone would render it (no artificial heavy bokeh)
camera.quality: 1080x1920 vertical video frame, slight phone sensor noise, mild compression, true-to-life colors

lighting.key: soft, diffused frontal light from a warm-white vanity light bar above the mirror, directly in front of him, behind the phone, lighting his whole face evenly from the front
lighting.fill: soft morning daylight bouncing off the white tiles
lighting.mood: bright, fresh and realistic; both sides of the face equally lit with the same brightness and no side shadows, only very soft natural shading under the chin and nose; accurate skin tones, low contrast

realism_rules: natural and authentic, like an everyday phone video, not a stock photo
real skin texture, no smoothing, no beauty filter, no plastic or waxy skin
natural fabric folds and wrinkles on the t-shirt
correct human anatomy: two hands, five fingers each, natural proportions, a natural grip on the bottle
realistic eyes with natural catchlights from the light in front of him
even, symmetrical illumination on the face, as when someone films himself facing the mirror light
negative: text, captions, subtitles, logos, watermarks, UI elements, any writing or brand on the bottle label
side lighting, split lighting, one half of the face darker than the other, strong shadows on one side of the face
studio lighting, ring light reflections, cinematic color grading, heavy bokeh
extra or deformed fingers, distorted hands, a deformed or floating bottle, asymmetrical eyes, warped face
smooth or airbrushed skin, 3D render, cartoon, illustration, CGI look
shirtless, towel around the neck, shaving foam, steam
big smile showing teeth, exaggerated expression, posing
cluttered counter, many products, other people, a visible mirror reflection
